headline: Approved several school policy sections in category J, including JIB, JICC, JICE, JICF, JICFA, JICFA-E, JICH, and JICH-R.
summary: The Policy Subcommittee reviewed and acted on multiple school policies in Sections I and J. Several policies were approved, some were held for further review, and others were removed or kept as the old version.
decisions: Policy JI was held for questions about rights listed.
Policy JIC was held for admin review.
Policy JICA was held because there is a plan to move forward on collecting data (crown act).
Policy JICFH kept the old version instead of a new one.

decision_evidence.quote: JI: HOLD for questions about rights listed
JICA: HOLD there is a plan to move forward on collecting data (crown act)
